moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Live Show
moments.blurb: The competition heats up on Strictly Come Dancing this Saturday, November 7th, as couples aim to impress the judges and avoid elimination, building towards the iconic Blackpool Week on November 21st.

angles.name: Weekend anticipation
angles.copy: Who's ready for another dose of Strictly sparkle? The dancefloor drama continues this weekend as our favourite couples battle it out. Any predictions for who'll ace it?

angles.name: Journey to Blackpool
angles.copy: The road to Blackpool is getting shorter! With only a few weeks until the Tower Ballroom, every step counts on Strictly. Who are you rooting for to make it?

moments.title: Bonfire Night Celebrations Across the UK
moments.blurb: Bonfire Night is officially on Thursday, November 5th, but fireworks displays and bonfires are lighting up skies across the UK this week and weekend, with many major events planned for Saturday, November 7th.

angles.name: Safety reminder
angles.copy: Remember, remember the 5th of November! Bonfire Night is almost here. If you're heading to a display or having fireworks at home, stay safe and follow all guidelines.

angles.name: Local events highlight
angles.copy: The skies are set to sparkle this week! Bonfire Night events are happening across the region. Where are you heading for your fireworks fix?

moments.title: Stevie Wonder 'Songs In The Key of Life' Tour in London
moments.blurb: Music icon Stevie Wonder brings his 'Songs In The Key of Life' 50th Anniversary Tour to The O2 in London for two nights, November 3rd and 5th, performing the legendary album in its entirety.

angles.name: Anticipation for the show
angles.copy: London, get ready for a true legend! Stevie Wonder is at The O2 this week, celebrating 50 years of 'Songs In The Key of Life'. Who's lucky enough to be going?

angles.name: Album tribute
angles.copy: It's a masterpiece being performed live! Stevie Wonder's 'Songs In The Key of Life' is 50, and he's playing it all at The O2. Which track are you most excited to hear?

moments.title: London Christmas Lights Switch-Ons Start This Week
moments.blurb: London begins its festive transformation this week with several iconic Christmas lights switch-on events, including Carnaby Street (Nov 4), Regent Street (Nov 5), Marylebone (Nov 11), and Covent Garden (Nov 12).

angles.name: Festive kick-off
angles.copy: It's beginning to look a lot like Christmas in London! The first festive lights switch-ons kick off this week. Where's your favourite display in the capital?

angles.name: Carnaby Street focus
angles.copy: Carnaby Street's Christmas lights are being switched on Wednesday! Get ready for the festive season to officially begin in London's West End.

moments.title: I'm A Celebrity...Get Me Out Of Here! Returns
moments.blurb: Ant & Dec are heading back to the jungle as the 26th series of I'm A Celebrity...Get Me Out Of Here! is set to launch on ITV on Monday, November 16th.

angles.name: Anticipation for launch
angles.copy: The jungle is calling! I'm A Celebrity...Get Me Out Of Here! is back on November 16th. Who are you hoping to see in the camp this year?

angles.name: Hosts return
angles.copy: Ant & Dec are returning to Australia! Get ready for another series of trials, tensions, and triumphs when I'm A Celeb launches mid-November.

moments.title: Roy Wood of The Move, ELO, Wizzard turns 80
moments.blurb: British rock icon Roy Wood, co-founder of The Move and Electric Light Orchestra, and frontman of Wizzard, celebrates his 80th birthday on November 8th.

angles.name: Celebrating a rock legend
angles.copy: Happy 80th birthday to the legendary Roy Wood! From The Move to ELO and Wizzard, his influence on British rock is undeniable. What's your favourite Roy Wood track?

angles.name: Wizzard festive classic
angles.copy: It's Roy Wood's 80th on November 8th! We can't talk about him without thinking of that iconic Christmas song... but which of his bands do you love most?

moments.title: Bryan Adams Turns 67
moments.blurb: Canadian rock superstar Bryan Adams, known for anthems like 'Summer of 69' and '(Everything I Do) I Do It for You', celebrates his 67th birthday on November 5th.

angles.name: Birthday wishes
angles.copy: Happy 67th Birthday to the one and only Bryan Adams on November 5th! What's your go-to Bryan Adams power ballad or rock anthem?

angles.name: Iconic song choice
angles.copy: It's Bryan Adams' birthday this week! If you could only pick one: 'Summer of 69' or '(Everything I Do) I Do It for You'? Let us know!

moments.title: Premier League Action This Weekend
moments.blurb: The Premier League delivers another packed weekend of football, featuring Everton vs Coventry (Friday 6th), Leeds vs Spurs (Saturday 7th), and Brighton vs Brentford and Crystal Palace vs Liverpool (Sunday 8th).

angles.name: Weekend fixtures preview
angles.copy: Get ready for some serious Premier League action this weekend! Kicking off with Everton vs Coventry on Friday, then Leeds vs Spurs, Brighton vs Brentford and Crystal Palace vs Liverpool. Which match are you most looking forward to?

angles.name: Local team focus
angles.copy: Big weekend for Leeds fans as they take on Spurs on Saturday! How do you think the Whites will fare?
